scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:standard: pnpm --filter @workspace/web run build:standard && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:standard
scripts.build:protected: pnpm --filter @workspace/web run build:protected && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:protected
scripts.build:android:offline: VITE_OFFLINE_MODE=1 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/web run build && pnpm exec cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
